label: Gills do not ventilate in air
statement_en: uptakeInAir = 0; hence over a flight of duration t the mean aerobic power is at most E S / t for an O2 store S.

hypotheses.name: Delphi.Empirical.NoAerialUptake
hypotheses.statement: uptakeInAir = 0; hence over a flight of duration t the mean aerobic power is at most E S / t for an O2 store S.
hypotheses.source: physiology/index.js (the chain sets uptake to zero in air) and its self-test, where the store drains
hypotheses.observation: O2 uptake is zero while airborne, so airborne aerobic work is paid for out of the store carried into the air, and the airborne aerobic ceiling falls as the flight lengthens.

scope.basis: physiology/index.js: gills do not ventilate in air; larval cutaneous uptake is not modelled, so larvae are outside
scope.note: Bounds the AEROBIC part only, and takes the store and the oxycaloric equivalent as inputs: neither is measured for Exocoetidae here. Cutaneous and buccal exchange in air are not modelled, and burst (anaerobic) power is outside it.
